role: Makes a zombie (or a non-nocturnal golem at night) walk through a village door by door: picks the nearest unvisited door of the nearest village, paths to it with door-breaking off, and remembers visited doors.

members.name: theEntity
members.note: folded: the task runs on the owning struct living

members.name: entityPathNavigate
members.note: not stored: the native shouldExecute paths directly with nav_try_move_to_xyz, so the Java field's round trip through startExecuting is equivalent

members.name: isNocturnal
members.note: ai_task.nocturnal; the golem passes true, the zombie false

members.name: doorList
members.note: ai_task.visited_doors[16][3] with nvisited_doors, a fixed-capacity ring instead of the ArrayList

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: AIC_MOVE_THROUGH_VILLAGE case: trims the visited list, the nocturnal daytime block, findNearestVillage(0), the nearest unvisited door, then paths with can_pass_closed_doors cleared and falls back to findRandomTargetBlockTowards(10,7)

members.name: func_75412_a
members.note: inlined: the nearest-door scan in the shouldExecute case

members.name: startExecuting
members.note: no-op case: the path was already set in shouldExecute

members.name: resetTask
members.note: records the door as visited when there is no path or the door is within 4 blocks
